title: Calisthenics Beginner to advanced program
author: Adam Elmetwally
desc:
Calisthenics program to unlock tuck planche (progress by changing the progression), build a solid base to help unlock front lever unlock handstand and muscle up. 

Prerequisites:
- 30 - 40 pushups
- 30 dips
- 10 - 15 pull ups
